description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types observed in a study, likely related to responses or selections made by participants. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different error category. These categories are “Perceptual Error” (pink, 37%), “Repeat Thinking and No Answer” (blue, 12%), “Correct Answer but Wrong Choice” (light blue, 15%), “Reasoning Error” (purple, 20%), “Lack of Knowledge” (light green, 9%), and “Choice Format Error” (dark green, 4%). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size, starting with “Perceptual Error” at the top and proceeding clockwise. A legend is not present, but each slice is labeled with an arrow pointing to it. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
